items.title: Unsloth publishes a local-run guide for Inkling 2 Mini with memory sizes from 9 GB (1-bit) to 24 GB (8-bit)
items.summary: Unsloth's guide shows how to run Thinking Machines' Inkling 2 Mini locally with Unsloth and llama.cpp. The quoted figures are about 9 GB of RAM at 1-bit, 17-18 GB at 4-bit and 24 GB at 8-bit, so the model fits laptops and small GPUs.

doubt.pushback: Memory figures are relayed from the guide in the post; not run by Magpie.

items.title: TRL adds an SFT example that post-trains Inkling 2 Mini on a clock-reading task
items.summary: Hugging Face's TRL repo now has examples/sft_inkling_2_mini_clocks, a worked supervised fine-tuning recipe for the looped Inkling 2 Mini, with a short demo video. A roster account also notes the model is now supported in TRL.

doubt.pushback: Example directory exists; no training results read.

items.title: InferenceBench lists Gemini 4 Neon in the top 3 agents for optimizing LLM inference, slightly above GPT-6.2 Astra at Ultra reasoning
items.summary: InferenceBench gives coding agents a base model, hardware and a two-hour budget to build a faster OpenAI-compatible server, scored as speedup over a PyTorch baseline. The post reports Gemini 4 Neon third overall, just ahead of GPT-6.2 Astra (Ultra reasoning); the leaderboard is rendered client-side, so the ranking was not independently read.

doubt.pushback: Ranking is the poster's reading of the leaderboard; page confirms the benchmark and method but ranks load by script.
